Additionally, the guitar hardware shows minor melting/imprecision in strings and bridges (severity 2). While these are notable defects, they do not constitute catastrophic failure; the objects remain recognizable and grounded. The depth map statistics show reasonable variance, supporting overall spatial coherence despite local artifacts.
